description: Land  Title Settlement Department -   Ellakkala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 510601 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels (Land No. 30 and Land No. 78) with detailed property descriptions, cadastral map references, and ownership details.
